settlements.basis: Commons陆侧访问、低地居民需求与向山地的长期交换重叠；连续低地使市场、较长存留和生活服务可共享，不必在近邻复制两个完整中心
settlements.definition: buildings + internal circulation + small shared/work/service open space; not building footprint
settlements.external_supply: 有限跨域生活品与材料输入，先核水/库存/通行，不假定无限供给
settlements.L2_sensitivity: 共同访问与地方住户不能被装卸封住；砂面/岸缘/供水不均，不能把全部73566搜索地当容量

settlements.basis: 第二大平缓组与East北段直接接触；山地生活品、整备/部分处理和批次存留不必全下低地再返回。较大本地日常生活支撑避免纯转运设施

settlements.basis: 上升路段与本地台地生活需求值得近处服务；小平缓组不足以在未证吞吐下再复制区域市场

settlements.basis: 南谷有较小连续缓地及自身生活/接近需求；南岸距离短不消除约80–90格爬升，故先是谷地生活点，非大港镇

building_footprint: UNRESOLVED; must not multiply by a universal coverage factor
regional_external_routes: not included in settlement built-fabric; future de-duplicate before whole-land-use accounting
remaining_semantics: non-settlement-fabric arithmetic remainder; includes productive/open/slope/shore/access/vegetation land, not an allocated land-use polygon
density_test: Same-definition final Middle coverage must exceed West and East; sibling coverages not yet known, so CONDITIONAL_NOT_EMPIRICALLY_PROVEN
